# `company.inventory_placements`

Immutable quantity-only ledger of where stock is: every movement and transfer placed at a site.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable placement. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_placements_item, ix_inventory_placements_site | items.id | Item whose units this places. |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_placements_site | inventory_sites.id | Site the units are at. |
| `bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin the units are in; null for no bin. |
| `lot_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | lots.id | Lot the units carry; null when unassigned. |
| `serial_number_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | serial_numbers.id | Serial number of the unit; null when unassigned. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Signed quantity placed, micro-units; never zero. |
| `effective_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_placements_item, ix_inventory_placements_site | — | Date the units are there from, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `count_position` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | before or after the counts of its site on its date, or count for a count's own difference. |
| `sequence` | BIGINT | no | — | — | ix_inventory_placements_item, ix_inventory_placements_sequence | — | Company-wide recorded order, shared with movements. |
| `source` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | What wrote it: movement, transfer, assignment or count. |
| `movement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_inventory_placements_movement | inventory_movements.id | Movement whose quantity this places; null unless the source is a movement. |
| `transfer_revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_inventory_placements_transfer | inventory_transfer_revisions.id | Transfer revision that moved these units; null unless the source is a transfer. |
| `source_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Line of the source document this placement belongs to; null on a movement. |
| `reverses_placement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | unique | — | inventory_placements.id | Placement this one exactly retires; null unless a reversal. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this placement was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this placement. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this placement. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this placement. |
